evidence: The RMS roughness values of the silicon nitride films prepared at 515, 557 and 573 °C were 0.17 nm, 0.33 nm and 0.31 nm, respectively, whereas that of LPCVD film was 0.66 nm. The deposited films are nonstoichiometric SiN, and were easily oxidized by air exposure to contain 7 –8 at.% of oxygen in the bulk film.
